Common questions

### Everything you need to know.

If your question isn't here, message us on WhatsApp — we reply fast.

How is ADV different from other digital marketing agencies in Malaysia?
+

ADV differs in three ways: outcome-aligned work (we agree measurable targets at the start and report against them weekly, and for selected clients part of the fee is tied to those targets), full-stack infrastructure (we build the system — CRM, automation, attribution, reporting — not just the campaigns), and AI-powered execution (we use AI tools to scale output and reduce cost per lead). Past results include a 17.3× blended ROAS for a fashion e-commerce client, 393% lead volume growth for an insurance platform, and a 56% CPL reduction in 30 days for a B2B services client.

How do your fees work?
+

ADV charges a monthly management fee. Management fees start from RM800 a month, depending on objective and account size. We agree measurable targets, such as cost per lead, ROAS or revenue, at the start and report against them weekly. For selected clients, part of the fee is tied to those targets through profit sharing. Message us on WhatsApp at +60 16 334 3549 or email Alvin.Yap@advmarketing.biz to talk through what fits your business.

What types of businesses do you work with?
+

ADV primarily works with B2B businesses and growth-stage SMEs across Malaysia and Southeast Asia — including professional services, insurance and fintech, health and wellness, beauty clinics, food and beverage, fashion and e-commerce, education, and media production. ADV is best suited for businesses with an existing product or service that are ready to invest in scalable marketing systems.

What does "marketing infrastructure" actually mean?
+

Marketing infrastructure is the underlying system that makes campaigns perform — CRM setup and lead pipeline management, ad account structure across Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok, attribution tracking via Google Analytics 4 and Meta Pixel, automation workflows for lead nurturing, content systems for consistent output, and custom reporting dashboards. Infrastructure is what makes every ringgit compound over time instead of resetting with each new campaign.

What is AEO and GEO, and why does it matter?
+

AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) structures your content so AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, and Apple Intelligence can accurately extract and cite your business. GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) ensures your brand appears in AI-generated summaries and Google AI Overviews. Both matter because a growing share of discovery now happens through AI rather than traditional search. We implement AEO and GEO through answer-first content, entity pages and accurate structured data.

What ad platforms does ADV manage?
+

ADV manages paid campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube), and TikTok Ads. On Google, ADV has managed budgets from RM5,000 to RM20,000/month — delivering a 45% CPL drop and 393% lead growth over 12 months. On Meta, ADV has cut CPL by 36 to 56% within 1 to 3 months. A multi-channel retail campaign returned 17.3× ROAS.

How long before I see results?
+

For paid media on Meta, Google, or TikTok, measurable results appear within 2–4 weeks. Significant CPL improvements typically occur within 1–3 months as creative testing and audience data compound. For SEO, AEO, and organic content, traction builds over 3–6 months. Marketing infrastructure setup — CRM, automation, attribution — is operational within 30 days, with compound gains visible over 3–6 months.

What budget do I need to work with ADV?
+

ADV has worked across a wide range — from RM500 awareness campaigns for F&B brands to RM20,000/month performance campaigns for fintech clients. For Meta lead generation, we suggest at least RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month in ad spend. Below that, results come too slowly to judge. Management fees start from RM800 a month, depending on objective and account size. Profit sharing is available for selected clients. Contact us via WhatsApp at +60 16 334 3549 to discuss what fits your business.

Do you work with businesses outside Malaysia?
+

Yes. ADV is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, but works with clients across Southeast Asia including Singapore and Indonesia. All campaign management, reporting, strategy, and communication is handled digitally — location doesn't affect delivery quality. Primary contact is WhatsApp (+60163343549) and email (sales@advmarketing.biz).

How do I get started with ADV?
+

Message us on WhatsApp at +60 16 334 3549 or email Alvin.Yap@advmarketing.biz. No formal brief needed. Just tell us about your business and what you're trying to grow, and we'll respond with an honest assessment of where we can help.

## About ADV Digital Marketing

Advertising in Malaysia · 2026

## What Ads Actually Cost in Malaysia

Not industry averages copied from a US blog — real CPM, CPC and cost-per-lead figures measured across past and current Malaysian client accounts, by channel, with the budget floors each one needs to work.

Get a Budget Recommendation
See the Numbers

"Most Malaysian ad budgets aren't too small. They're spread too thin."

The short answer

In Malaysia, Meta CPMs run roughly RM1.27–15 and a qualified lead conversation costs RM7 to RM25 in most accounts, above RM40 in harder verticals such as beauty. Google Search CPCs run RM7.50–14 on competitive terms, with cost per acquisition from RM2.41 in high-volume insurance to RM91.47 in specialist healthcare (30 days to 5 Oct 2026). These are figures from past and current client accounts, not published averages.

RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month is our practical floor for Meta lead generation. Below it, results come too slowly to judge. In our accounts, Google Search needs around RM3,000 a month. Multi-channel becomes viable around RM5,000. Agency management fees sit on top of ad spend. Management fees start from RM800 a month, depending on objective and account size.

Which to start with: Google Search if people already search for what you sell; Meta if your product needs to be shown before anyone thinks to search for it. Under RM3,000/month, run one channel properly rather than two badly.

Choosing a channel

### Intent decides, not preference.

Does anyone search for what you sell? If a person with your problem types it into Google — "aircond service kl", "EV charger installation", "invisalign price" — then Google Search is where the money is. You're capturing demand that already exists, at the moment it exists. Higher cost per click, far higher intent.

Or does your product need to be seen first? Nobody searches for a skincare brand they've never heard of, or a restaurant that opened last week. Meta creates the demand Google later captures. Lower cost per impression, more work to convert.

Under RM3,000/month, pick one. The most common mistake we see in Malaysian accounts is a RM2,000 budget split across Meta and Google, leaving both too thin to produce results you can judge. One channel at RM2,000 beats two at RM1,000 every time — not marginally, but categorically.

Then measure honestly. Channel choice matters far less than measurement quality: an account with broken conversion tracking wastes budget identically on every platform. That's the first thing we fix in Meta takeovers and Google Ads takeovers alike.

Common questions

### Budget questions we get asked.

Straight answers on Malaysian ad costs, benchmarks and where to start.

How much does advertising cost in Malaysia? +
Meta CPMs run RM1.27–15. A lead conversation costs RM7 to RM25 in most accounts, above RM40 in harder verticals such as beauty. Google Search CPCs run RM7.50–14 on competitive terms, with CPA from RM2.41 in high-volume insurance to RM91.47 in specialist healthcare (30 days to 5 Oct 2026). Ad spend excludes management fees. Management fees start from RM800 a month, depending on objective and account size. See our pricing page .

Which channel should I start with? +
Google Search if people already search for what you sell — it captures existing intent. Meta if your product needs to be shown or explained first. Under RM3,000/month, run one channel properly rather than splitting a thin budget across both.

What's a good CPM in Malaysia? +
On awareness campaigns, RM1.27–1.41 is achievable with broad targeting and strong creative. Conversion-optimised campaigns run RM10–15 because the algorithm bids for a narrower, higher-value audience. A rising CPM on a stable audience usually signals creative fatigue, not market conditions.

Is Malaysia cheaper than Singapore or the US? +
Substantially — Malaysian CPMs and CPCs run a fraction of comparable Singapore or US auction prices. In our view, part of the reason is that fewer advertisers compete per head of population. That makes Malaysia an efficient place to test creative before scaling into pricier regional markets.

How much should an SME budget monthly? +
RM1,500–2,000 for Meta lead generation, around RM3,000 for Google Search in our accounts, RM5,000+ before multi-channel makes sense. Agency management fees sit on top. Management fees start from RM800 a month, depending on objective and account size.

Meta ads services

### Meta ads services in Malaysia: every placement, one strategy.

Our Meta ads services cover the full spectrum of Facebook and Instagram advertising — from awareness to cart recovery — structured as a single revenue system, not isolated campaigns.

#### Facebook Ads

Campaign strategy, audience targeting, creative briefs, and A/B testing — built on a data-first structure that compounds with every ringgit spent.

#### Instagram Ads

Reels, Stories, and Feed placements with a mobile-first creative approach. We design for scroll-stop, then optimise for conversion.

#### Meta Retargeting

Warm audience sequences, cart recovery flows, and cross-sell funnels that bring back the prospects who didn't convert the first time.

#### Lookalike Audiences

AI-powered audience expansion seeded from your best customers — so Meta finds new prospects who behave like the ones already buying from you.

#### Meta Shopping

Catalogue ads, including Advantage+ catalog ads (formerly dynamic product ads), that surface the right SKU to the right buyer at the right moment — built for Malaysian e-commerce brands.

#### Performance Reporting

Weekly reports, ROAS tracking, and attribution analysis delivered in plain language — so you always know exactly what your budget is producing.

The ADV approach

### We don't run ads. We build revenue systems.

Most Malaysian businesses come to us after months of boosted posts that spent their budget on reach without results. We start differently — with full-funnel architecture, not individual placements. Every campaign we build is designed as an interconnected system: cold traffic, warm retargeting, and loyalty — each layer feeding the next.

Creative testing is built into everything. We don't guess which ad angle works — we test methodically, kill losers fast, and scale what converts. This is the difference between ad spend and ad investment.

Signal comes first: pixel and Conversions API go in before a single campaign, so Meta learns from who actually bought — not who clicked. Advantage+ and AI bidding come after, where the data supports them. We build the signal, then let the machine work.

Common questions

### Questions we hear before every engagement.

Honest answers to the things Malaysian business owners always ask before committing to Meta Ads.

What's a realistic budget for Meta ads in Malaysia?
+

For lead generation, RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month is the practical floor in our accounts. Meta needs about 50 results a week per ad set to finish learning. On small budgets we run fewer ad sets so each one gets enough results. Most B2B and e-commerce budgets land at RM2,000–5,000/month once campaigns are proven.

How long before we see results?
+

We allow 2 to 4 weeks before judging results, because Meta's learning phase needs about 50 results per ad set. Meaningful ROAS typically shows by week 6–8 with proper creative testing. We set clear milestones at each stage so you always know what's normal and what's not.

Do you handle ad creative?
+

Yes. We brief creatives, write ad copy, and provide creative direction. Production can be handled by your team or ours — we're flexible based on what's already in place.

What's the difference between boosting a post and running a proper Meta campaign?
+

Boost = paying Meta for reach. Campaign = targeting by intent, behaviour, and lookalike — dramatically higher conversion rates. Boosting is exposure. A properly structured campaign is a revenue system.

Do you use AI in your Meta campaigns?
+

Yes. Meta's Advantage+ automation, AI content brief generation, and automated reporting are all standard in our workflow. We don't use AI as a buzzword — it's embedded in how we operate daily.

What industries do you work with in Malaysia?
+

B2B services, property, education, e-commerce, F&B, healthcare, and professional services. If your business sells a product or service that benefits from targeted digital distribution, Meta Ads likely has a role in your growth.

# Facebook Ads Malaysia — Account Takeover Guide
URL: https://advmarketing.biz/facebook-ads-malaysia
==============================================================================

Facebook Ads Malaysia — How We Fix Ad Accounts | ADV

← All guides & resources

中文版 →

Facebook Ads Malaysia · 2026 Guide

## How We Fix Facebook Ad Accounts

Most Malaysian businesses don't come to us with a blank slate — they come with an underperforming account. This is the exact process our consultancy runs to audit it, take it over without losing momentum, and optimise it — with the real RM numbers from doing it.

Get a Free Account Audit
Read the Process

"The account isn't broken. The signal it's feeding Meta usually is."

The short answer

Most underperforming Facebook ad accounts in Malaysia fail on measurement, not targeting. If the Meta pixel or Conversions API is missing or misconfigured, the algorithm optimises toward the wrong signal — no amount of audience or creative work fixes delivery built on bad data.

A proper account takeover runs in four steps: audit the account before changing it, repair measurement before spending, keep winning ad sets live while rebuilding the structure in parallel, then run a weekly creative-testing cadence. Pausing everything on day one is the most common and most expensive mistake, because it discards the learning the account has already paid for.

Realistic outcome: cost-per-lead reductions of 30–56% within 30–90 days of a correctly executed takeover. For lead generation, the practical ad spend floor in our accounts is RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month.

Why accounts underperform

### It's almost never the targeting.

After auditing accounts across B2B services, beauty, F&B, retail and healthcare in Malaysia, the same four problems explain most underperformance — and none of them are the audience settings everyone obsesses over.

#### 1. Broken measurement

No pixel, a half-installed pixel, or no Conversions API. Meta optimises toward the signal it receives — when conversions aren't recorded accurately, the algorithm literally cannot find your buyers. This is the single most common problem we find, and nothing else matters until it's fixed.

#### 2. Boosted-post budgets

Months of "Boost Post" spend optimised for engagement, not revenue. Boosting buys reach; a structured campaign builds a revenue system. The account has spend history, but none of it taught the algorithm who actually buys.

#### 3. Learning-phase churn

Every significant edit sends an ad set back into learning, so it never graduates. A RM3,000/month account stuck in learning loses to a stable RM1,500 one.

#### 4. Creative fatigue, no pipeline

Same ad for months: frequency climbs, CTR slides. It looks like "Facebook stopped working" — it's just the same ad shown too many times.

The takeover process

### Four steps. Measurement first.

The takeover, in four steps

Step 1 — The pre-takeover audit. Before touching anything: account structure, pixel and CAPI health, conversion-event definitions, attribution settings, creative history, audience overlap, and the last 90 days of spend-to-result data. We diagnose why performance is what it is before changing what it does. On our own site audits, we've found silently-broken tracking that reported fine for months — the same failure mode applies inside ad accounts.

Step 2 — Fix measurement before media. Pixel and Conversions API repaired or installed before a single ringgit of new spend. Bad signal in, bad delivery out — no exceptions. This is also where conversion events get redefined around what actually matters (a WhatsApp conversation, a booking) instead of vanity actions.

Step 3 — Preserve what works, rebuild in parallel. The classic agency-switch mistake is pausing everything on day one — it throws away every bit of learning the account has paid for. Anything winning keeps running untouched while the corrected structure is built alongside it. Budget migrates only as the new structure exits its learning phase.

Step 4 — The optimisation cadence. Weekly creative testing with explicit kill/scale rules, budget reallocated to winners, Advantage+ where the signal supports it, and plain-language weekly reporting — a lead now costs X, down from Y, because Z. Our clients see the same numbers we do, every week, on our Live Results Board .

What takeovers have produced

56%

CPL cut in 30 days on a B2B takeover and rebuild (RM37.40 → RM16.60)

36%

CPL cut over 3 months — beauty clinic on RM1,500–1,800/mo

17.3×

Blended ROAS — RM321K revenue on RM18.6K seasonal spend

42–52%

CPL cut mid-flight via one creative pivot — new pixel account

Common questions

### What Malaysian businesses ask before switching.

The questions we hear from business owners whose Facebook ads "used to work" or never did.

How much do Facebook ads cost in Malaysia?
+

Ad spend typically runs RM500–20,000/month depending on scale, with RM1,500–2,000/month the practical floor for lead generation in our accounts. Management fees are separate and start from RM800 a month, depending on objective and account size. See the full breakdown on our Meta ads pricing page . Typical Malaysian CPCs run RM0.50–3.00, with CPMs of RM8 to RM25 for conversion campaigns in our accounts. Awareness campaigns can run near RM1.30. More market benchmarks on our Malaysia statistics page .

Will switching agencies reset my account's performance?
+

Only if the takeover is done badly. Pausing everything on day one throws away the algorithm's accumulated learning. Done properly — winners preserved, corrected structure built in parallel, budget migrated gradually — performance is protected through the transition. Our fastest takeover cut cost per lead 56% in the first 30 days.

What should an audit check first?
+

Measurement before media: pixel and Conversions API health, conversion-event definitions, attribution settings. Most underperforming Malaysian accounts are feeding Meta bad or missing conversion signal — no amount of creative or targeting work fixes delivery built on wrong data.

How long until a taken-over account shows results?
+

Measurement fixes show within 1–2 weeks. Meaningful CPL or ROAS movement typically shows at 30 days, with compounding gains over 1–3 months as creative testing and audience data accumulate. Current numbers are on the Live Results Board .

Do I need a consultancy, or can I run ads myself?
+

Small budgets can start on our Starter tier , with management fees from RM800 a month. For lead generation, RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month in ad spend is the practical floor in our accounts, because below that results come too slowly to judge. Beyond that, it's an opportunity-cost question: a consultancy's job is to compress the expensive trial-and-error phase. If your cost per lead has been flat or rising for 3+ months, that's usually the signal to get an outside audit.

# 马来西亚 Facebook 广告投放指南 (Chinese edition)
URL: https://advmarketing.biz/zh/facebook-ads-malaysia
==============================================================================

马来西亚 FB 广告账户烧钱没结果？我们怎么修 | ADV

← 所有指南与资源

Read in English →

马来西亚 Facebook 广告 · 2026 中文指南

## 我们怎么修复 FB 广告账户

很多老板来找我们的时候，账户已经烧了几个月的钱，询问却没几个。下面是我们接手一个账户时真正在做的事 — 还有真实的马币数字。

免费账户审计
看流程

"账户没坏。 坏的是 喂给 Meta 的信号。"

讲白一点

在马来西亚，大部分 FB 广告账户表现差，问题不在受众，在追踪。 Pixel 或 Conversions API 没装好，Meta 就往错的方向优化 — 受众和素材怎么调都没用。

接手一个账户就四步：先审计，先修追踪，好的广告继续跑、新的在旁边搭，然后每周测素材。第一天就全部暂停？那是最贵的错误。

合理预期： 做对的话，30–90 天内潜在客户成本（CPL）降 30–56%。做询问的话，在我们的账户里，每月广告费 RM1,500 到 RM2,000 是比较实际的底线。

账户为什么表现差

### 问题几乎 不在受众。

审计过 B2B、美容、餐饮、零售、医疗的账户之后，来来去去就是这四个问题。

#### 1. 追踪坏了

没装 Pixel、装一半、或没接 CAPI。转化记录不到，Meta 就找不到你的买家。这是最常见的问题，没修好之前，其他都白做。

#### 2. 钱都拿去 Boost Post

Boost 买到的是互动，不是询问。账户花了几个月的钱，算法却没学到谁会买。

#### 3. 学习阶段一直重置

每做一次大改动，广告组就会重新进入学习阶段，所以永远毕不了业。卡在学习阶段的 RM3,000 账户，输给稳定跑的 RM1,500 账户。

#### 4. 素材疲劳

同一条广告跑太久：频次往上，点击往下。不是"FB 没用了"，是大家看腻了。

接手流程

### 四步。 追踪先。

接手的四个步骤

第一步 — 先审计。 账户结构、Pixel 和 CAPI、转化事件、归因、素材历史、过去 90 天的花费和结果。先搞清楚为什么差，再动手。

第二步 — 先修追踪，再花钱。 Pixel 和 CAPI 没修好之前，一分新预算都不投。转化事件也重新定义在真正有用的动作上 — 一段 WhatsApp 对话、一个预约。

第三步 — 好的留着，新的旁边搭。 换代理最常见的错误就是第一天全部暂停，等于把账户学到的东西全丢掉。有效的广告组照跑，新结构在旁边建好、跑出学习阶段之后，预算才慢慢搬过去。

第四步 — 每周优化。 每周测素材，该停的停、该加的加，预算往赢家放。每周用白话汇报：现在一个询问 X 块，之前 Y 块，因为 Z。数字都公开在 实时成果看板 。

接手后的实际成果

56%

30 天 CPL 降幅 · B2B 账户接手重建（RM37.40 → RM16.60）

36%

3 个月 CPL 降幅 · 美容诊所，每月 RM1,500–1,800

17.3×

综合 ROAS · RM18.6K 花费换 RM321K 营收

42–52%

一次换素材的 CPL 降幅 · 全新 Pixel 账户

常见问题

### 老板们换代理前 最常问的。

通常是 FB 广告"以前有效"、或者一直没效的老板问的。

在马来西亚投 FB 广告要多少钱？
+

一般每月 RM500 到 RM20,000，看规模。做询问的话，在我们的账户里，每月 RM1,500 到 RM2,000 是比较实际的底线。管理费另算，每月 RM800 起，看目标和账户规模，详细看 Meta 广告收费 （英文）。CPC 大概 RM0.50 到 RM3.00。在我们的账户里，转化广告的 CPM 大约 RM8 到 RM25，品牌曝光广告可以低到 RM1.30 左右。

换代理会不会让账户归零？
+

做错才会。第一天全部暂停，学习就没了。好的留着、新的旁边搭、预算慢慢搬，表现就保得住。我们最快的一次，30 天 CPL 降 56%。

审计先看什么？
+

先看追踪：Pixel、CAPI、转化事件、归因。大部分账户都在喂 Meta 错的信号 — 数据不对，其他怎么调都白调。

多久看到效果？
+

追踪修好，1–2 周就有感觉。CPL 或 ROAS 明显变化通常在 30 天，之后 1–3 个月持续放大。最新数字都在 实时成果看板 。

要找代理，还是自己投？
+

预算小的话，可以从我们的 Starter 配套 开始，管理费每月 RM800 起。做询问的话，在我们的账户里，每月广告费 RM1,500 到 RM2,000 是比较实际的底线，再低的话结果来得太慢，很难判断好坏。再往上，就看你愿不愿意花时间试错。CPL 已经三个月没降？那就该找人看看了。

开始

### 要不要 我们帮你看看账户？

给我们权限，免费跑一次审计 — 结构、Pixel、素材疲劳、预算漏在哪里。合不合作，报告都是你的。没有推销，中英文都可以聊。

WhatsApp 联系我们

工作时间内通常 2 小时内回复。

Pricing Guide

## Meta Ads Pricing Malaysia, 2026

What Facebook and Instagram advertising actually costs in Malaysia — ad spend, management fees, and the real RM results clients have seen at each budget tier.

Get a Free Audit
See Pricing Tiers

"The question isn't how much you spend. It's what you spend it on."

Budget tiers

### What you actually pay. No guesswork.

Ad spend goes directly to Meta. Management fees are separate and cover strategy, creative direction, and reporting. Here's how the two break down at each tier.

Tier

Management fees start from RM800 a month, depending on objective and account size. Above RM20,000 a month in ad spend, the fee is about 15% of ad spend. Profit sharing is available for selected clients.

Tiers and what each has produced

Meta needs about 50 results a week per ad set to finish learning. On small budgets we run fewer ad sets so each one gets enough results. Management fees don't scale linearly with ad spend; a well-run RM3,000/month account often outperforms a poorly targeted RM10,000/month one.

Real client results

### What each tier has actually produced.

Starter tier — Beauty & Wellness clinic, RM1,500–1,800/month. Cost-per-lead dropped 36% over 3 months, reaching RM14.04 by month 3 against a client target of ≤RM15. The best-performing creative achieved RM9.46 per conversion and built a 30,000+ warm retargeting pool.

Growth tier: B2B Services lead generation. We took over the Meta lead gen account and rebuilt it in 30 days. Cost-per-lead fell 56%, from RM37.40 to RM16.60. That is the fastest turnaround we've recorded on a takeover and rebuild.

Growth tier — Fashion & Retail, Ramadan campaign. RM18,588 total spend across Meta, Google, and TikTok over 51 days returned RM321,517 in revenue and 1,303 purchases — a 17.3× blended ROAS. Google alone delivered 26× ROAS within that mix.

Google Ads example (not Meta): Insurance & Fintech, 12-month Google Search + PMax. Budget scaled from RM5,000 to RM20,000/month. Lead volume grew 393% (1,336 → 6,586 leads/month at peak). Cost per lead fell 45%, from RM4.40 to RM2.41. See our Google Ads service .

Pricing questions

### What Malaysian business owners actually ask.

Straight answers on Meta ads budgets, fees, and what results are realistic at each spend level.

How much do Meta ads cost in Malaysia?
+

Ad spend to Meta typically runs RM500 for small awareness campaigns up to RM20,000/month for scaled performance campaigns. Agency management fees are separate. Ours start from RM800 a month, depending on objective and account size: from RM800 (up to RM1,500) at Starter, RM1,500 to RM2,500 at Growth, and RM2,500 to RM4,000 at Scale. Above RM20,000 a month in ad spend, the fee is about 15% of ad spend. A realistic floor for lead generation in our accounts is RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month in ad spend.

What's a realistic budget to start with?
+

For Meta lead generation, RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month is the practical floor in our accounts. Below that, results come too slowly to judge. Smaller budgets can still run on our Starter tier, and RM500 a month is possible for awareness campaigns. RM2,000 to RM5,000 is where most B2B budgets land.

What results can I expect for my budget?
+

It depends heavily on industry and starting point, but real examples: a beauty clinic on RM1,500–1,800/month reached a 36% CPL reduction over 3 months; a B2B services client on a similar budget saw a 56% CPL reduction in just 30 days; a fashion/retail brand spending RM18,588 across 51 days generated RM321,517 in revenue, a 17.3× blended ROAS.

Is a higher budget always better?
+

No. Meta needs about 50 results a week per ad set to finish learning. On small budgets we run fewer ad sets so each one gets enough results. Beyond that, results scale with budget but not linearly. A well-optimised RM3,000/month campaign often outperforms a poorly targeted RM10,000/month one.

Do management fees replace ad spend or come on top?
+

Management fees are separate from ad spend. Ad spend goes directly to Meta; the management fee covers strategy, creative direction, campaign structure, and reporting. Budgeting for both is what most first-time advertisers miss. For cross-channel benchmarks, see what ads cost in Malaysia .

How long until Meta ads pay for themselves?
+

We allow 2 to 4 weeks before judging results, because Meta's learning phase needs about 50 results per ad set. Meaningful ROAS typically shows by week 6–8 with proper creative testing, and CPL improvements of 30–50%+ are achievable within 1–3 months once creative and audience data compound.

ADV Digital Marketing · Google Ads Malaysia

Campaign types we run

### Every channel. Managed as one system.

Google's ad ecosystem is more complex than most businesses realise. We run the right campaign type for each stage of your funnel — and make them work together.

01

#### Search Campaigns

Keyword targeting, match types, Quality Score optimisation, negative keyword management. We capture buyers the moment they search — and ensure every click has intent behind it.

02

#### Performance Max

AI-driven cross-channel campaigns across Search, Display, YouTube, Gmail, and Maps — all from a single campaign. We structure PMAX asset groups by category and govern search terms to prevent early-phase budget waste.

03

#### Display & Remarketing

Brand awareness and retargeting across 2M+ websites in the Google Display Network. We re-engage warm audiences with the right message at the right frequency — without overexposure.

04

#### YouTube Advertising

In-stream, skippable, and bumper ads targeting Malaysian audiences by intent, demographics, and interests. YouTube is underpriced for B2B and high-consideration purchases — we know how to use it.

05

#### Google Shopping

Product listing ads for e-commerce with feed optimisation and bidding strategy. We structure Shopping campaigns by product margin — so your highest-value SKUs get the budget they deserve.

06

#### Keyword Strategy

Deep keyword research, search term analysis, bid management, and competitive intelligence. We map keywords to intent stages — informational, commercial, transactional — and build campaigns around that architecture.

The ADV approach

### We treat every ringgit like it's our own.

Full-funnel keyword mapping. Not just broad match. We build keyword architecture across awareness, consideration, and conversion stages — so every stage of your buyer's journey is covered without cannibalising budget.

Landing page alignment. Most agencies ignore this — we don't. A high Quality Score is meaningless if your landing page loses the visitor. We audit and brief landing page improvements as part of campaign management.

Negative keyword hygiene. Irrelevant clicks are silent budget killers. We run weekly search term reviews and maintain aggressive negative keyword lists from day one — especially critical in PMAX's early learning phase.

PMAX vs Search balance. In the Malaysian market, full PMAX reliance often dilutes intent-rich Search traffic. We calibrate the budget split based on your conversion data, not Google's defaults.

Common questions

### Google Ads questions, answered honestly.

No jargon. No upselling. Just straight answers to what Malaysian businesses ask before committing to Google Ads.

Have a question that's not here? Message us on WhatsApp — we'll give you a straight answer within a few hours.

What's the minimum Google Ads budget in Malaysia?
+

Google has no minimum. We suggest RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month in ad spend, and around RM3,000 for Search in competitive categories. With less, results come in too slowly to judge what is working.

Google Ads vs Meta Ads — which is better?
+

Different intent. Google captures active searchers (high intent) — people already looking for what you sell. Meta builds demand (broader audience) — it puts your brand in front of people who don't know they need you yet. Most businesses need both for a complete funnel. If you can only choose one, lead with Google Ads for bottom-of-funnel conversions, then add Meta once you have budget for upper-funnel demand generation.

How do you handle PMAX campaigns?
+

We structure PMAX asset groups by product or service category, monitor search term reports closely, and use negative keyword lists to prevent budget waste in early phases. PMAX is powerful but can burn budget on irrelevant placements without tight governance. We treat PMAX as a complement to Search — not a replacement — and calibrate the balance based on your specific customer journey and market maturity.

What's a Quality Score and why does it matter?
+

Quality Score is Google's 1 to 10 diagnostic for keyword, ad and landing page relevance. Google says higher quality ads can often lead to lower costs per click. We optimise all three layers: keyword match and intent alignment, ad copy relevance and CTR, and landing page experience including load speed and message match.

Do you manage the ad account or just advise?
+

Full management. We own the day-to-day: bid adjustments, search term monitoring, A/B testing of ad copy and landing pages, negative keyword lists, audience exclusions, and weekly reporting with plain-English commentary. You'll have full visibility into the account at all times, and we'll walk you through every significant change we make and why.

How long before Google Ads starts converting?
+

Search campaigns typically show conversion data within 2–3 weeks, once tracking is verified and enough impressions have accumulated. Google recommends running a new Performance Max campaign for at least 6 weeks. It says Smart Bidding can take up to around 50 conversion events or three conversion cycles to calibrate. We set clear expectations for each phase: data collection, early optimisation, and scaled performance.

Is Google Ads the same as Google AdWords or SEM?
+

Yes, mostly. Google AdWords was renamed Google Ads in 2018, so it is the same platform. SEM, or search engine marketing, is the wider term for paid search, and in Malaysia that almost always means Google Ads. We manage all of it: Search, Performance Max, Display and YouTube.

Do you work with businesses in Johor Bahru?
+

Yes. We are based in Kuala Lumpur and manage Google Ads for businesses across Malaysia, including Johor and Selangor. Account access, weekly reporting and calls all run remotely, so your location makes no difference to how the account is managed.

Google Ads Malaysia — How We Fix Ad Accounts | ADV

Google Ads Malaysia · 2026 Guide

## How We Fix Google Ad Accounts

Search, PMAX, Display — most accounts we take over aren't broken by bad products or high CPCs. They're broken by unread search-term reports and conversion events that don't mean revenue. This is the process we run to fix them.

Get a Free Account Audit
Read the Process

"High CPC isn't the problem. Paying it for the wrong searches is."

The short answer

Most wasted Google Ads budget in Malaysia hides in two places: conversion events that don't represent revenue, and search-term reports nobody reads. Smart bidding optimises toward whatever it is told a conversion is — feed it page views or button clicks and it will scale the wrong outcome efficiently.

A proper takeover runs in four steps: pull 90 days of search terms and conversion definitions before changing anything, redefine conversion events around real revenue actions, restructure gradually so accumulated smart-bidding signal is preserved rather than reset, then run weekly search-term hygiene and Quality Score work.

Realistic outcome: better ad and landing page quality can often lower what you pay per click. Around RM3,000 a month suits Search in competitive categories.

Why accounts underperform

### Four leaks we find in almost every audit.

Across insurance, healthcare, retail and B2B accounts in Malaysia, the same four problems explain most wasted Google Ads budget — and all four are visible in reports most advertisers never open.

#### 1. Conversions that aren't revenue

Smart bidding scales whatever it's told a conversion is. Count page views as conversions and the account "converts" beautifully while the phone stays silent.

#### 2. Unread search-term reports

Broad match with no negative keywords quietly spends on searches that will never buy — in our audits, 20–40% of the budget.

#### 3. Ungoverned PMAX

Performance Max without brand exclusions cannibalises searches you'd win free, and without placement monitoring it burns budget on low-quality inventory. PMAX is powerful — as a governed complement to Search, not a set-and-forget replacement.

#### 4. Quality Score neglect

Better ad and landing page quality can often lower what you pay per click. Neglect it and every click carries a silent tax, invisible unless someone looks.

The takeover process

### Four steps. Nothing gets reset.

The takeover, in four steps

Step 1 — The pre-takeover audit. The last 90 days of search-term reports, conversion definitions, attribution settings, Quality Score distribution, brand versus non-brand split, and PMAX placements. Most wasted budget hides in the search terms nobody has read — we read them before deciding anything.

Step 2 — Fix measurement before media. Conversion events redefined around actions that mean revenue — a form submission, a WhatsApp conversation, a call — and GA4 linkage verified before any bid-strategy change. Feeding smart bidding the wrong event scales the wrong outcome faster.

Step 3 — Restructure without resetting. Smart Bidding learns from conversion history across your campaigns, and wholesale rebuilds throw that away. Converting campaigns stay live while negatives tighten, brand splits from non-brand, and PMAX gets governed. Budget migrates gradually — momentum preserved.

Step 4 — The optimisation cadence. Weekly search-term hygiene, negative-list growth, budget to winners, Quality Score work, and plain-language reporting — a lead now costs X, down from Y, because Z. Current account numbers stay published on our Live Results Board .

Lead growth over 12 months — insurance & fintech platform (1,336 → 6,586/mo)

RM2.41

CPL, down 45% — while scaling spend RM5K → RM20K/month

RM91.47

CPA, healthcare account, 30 days to 5 Oct 2026

26×

ROAS — Google slice of a multi-channel retail campaign

Common questions

### What Malaysian businesses ask about Google Ads.

Straight answers on budgets, PMAX, CPCs, and what switching actually does to an account.

What's the minimum Google Ads budget in Malaysia?
+

Google has no minimum. We suggest RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month in ad spend. Around RM3,000 a month suits Search in competitive categories such as insurance, legal and healthcare. With less, results come in too slowly to judge what is working.

Will switching agencies reset my smart bidding?
+

Not if the takeover preserves structure. Wholesale rebuilds throw away accumulated signal; a gradual restructure that keeps converting campaigns live protects it. One takeover scaled from RM5,000 to RM20,000/month while cutting CPL 45% — precisely because nothing was reset.

Why is my cost per click so high?
+

Usually Quality Score, not the market. Better ad and landing page quality can often lower what you pay per click. The other usual cause: broad-match keywords spending on irrelevant searches no one has excluded.

Is Performance Max worth running?
+

Yes, with governance — brand exclusions, category-structured asset groups, placement monitoring. Ungoverned, it cannibalises brand searches you'd win free. Our longest-running Search + PMAX account grew lead volume 393% over 12 months.

Google Ads or Facebook ads first?
+

Different intent: Google captures people already searching for what you sell; Meta builds demand among people who don't know you yet. If forced to choose, lead with Google for bottom-of-funnel conversions — then read our Facebook ads guide when you're ready to add the demand layer.

# Google Ads Pricing Malaysia 2026

Google Ads Pricing Malaysia 2026: Real Costs in RM | ADV

← All guides & resources

Google Ads Pricing · 2026 Guide

## Google Ads Pricing Malaysia, 2026

What Google Ads actually costs a Malaysian business: the ad spend, the management fee, real RM bid ranges, and how to tell if you are paying too much.

Get a Free Account Audit
See the Breakdown

"A cheap click isn't cheap if it never turns into a sale."

The short answer

Google Ads in Malaysia has two costs: the ad spend you pay Google per click, plus 8% SST, and a management fee if someone runs the account for you. Google has no minimum spend, but RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month is the practical floor for usable data, and around RM3,000 suits Search in competitive categories. Clicks range from a few ringgit to over RM300 depending on the keyword, so cost per lead varies widely by industry.

The two costs

### What are the two costs of Google Ads in Malaysia?

You pay Google for clicks, plus 8% SST. If someone runs the account for you, their fee is a separate monthly cost on top.

Cost 1

#### Ad spend

Paid straight to Google. On Search, only when someone clicks. You set the budget.

No flat fee No subscription + 8% SST

Cost 2

#### Management fee

Paid to whoever runs the account. It sits on top of ad spend, not inside it.

Do it yourself: your time Hire help: monthly fee

Always ask which of the two numbers a quote covers.

Where an example month goes

Illustration using the low end of ADV's published fee range. Fee shown excluding tax.

Read the detail
Every Google Ads budget splits into money that buys clicks and money that pays for running the account. Most first-time advertisers only budget for the first.

The first cost is ad spend. It goes straight to Google, and on Search you only pay it when someone clicks your ad. Google charges no flat fee and no monthly subscription, and you set the budget yourself (Source: Google Ads Help, 2026). Google Ads accounts with a Malaysian business address are also subject to 8% sales and service tax, which has applied since 1 March 2024 (Source: Google Ads Help, 2026).

The second cost is management. That is what you pay a person or agency to pick keywords, write ads, set up conversion tracking, read the search terms and move budget to what works. Run the account yourself and this cost is your time. Hire someone and it is a monthly fee that sits on top of ad spend, not inside it.

Always ask which of the two numbers you are being quoted. A "RM3,000 package" that includes the fee can leave far less for clicks than you think. When we scope a Google Ads management engagement , ad spend and fee are always written as two separate lines.

How Google charges

### How does Google charge for ads?

Each search is an auction. You pay per click, often less than your bid, and your daily budget caps the monthly bill.

01

#### An auction on every search

Google uses Ad Rank to pick which ads show, and in what order.

02

#### You pay up to your bid

Often less. Just enough to beat the ad ranked below you.

03

#### The daily budget rules

2× daily budget, max on one busy day

30.4× daily budget, max for the month

RM100 a day never bills more than RM3,040 a month.

Read the detail
Google Ads runs an auction every time someone searches. Your ad competes with every other advertiser bidding on that search, and Google uses Ad Rank to decide which ads show and in what order.

On Search you pay per click. Your maximum cost per click bid is the most you will typically pay, but Google says you are often charged less, sometimes much less. You only pay what is needed to clear the Ad Rank thresholds and beat the advertiser ranked just below you (Source: Google Ads Help, 2026).

You control spend with an average daily budget for each campaign. Two rules catch people out:

- On a single day , a campaign can spend up to two times its average daily budget, so Google can take advantage of busy traffic days.

- Across the month , it will not spend more than 30.4 times the average daily budget (Source: Google Ads Help, 2026).

A campaign set at RM100 a day might spend RM170 on a busy Monday and RM40 on a quiet Sunday, but it will not bill more than RM3,040 for the month. A day at double budget is normal. Judge the monthly total.

Cost per click

### What drives your cost per click?

Competition, quality and context set your price per click. Quality is the one lever fully in your control.

#### Competition

More advertisers chasing the same top spots pushes the price up.

Your bid Thresholds Competing ads

In your control

#### Quality

Higher quality ads can often lead to lower CPCs.

Ad Landing page

#### Context

What was searched, and where, when and on what device.

Search term Location Device Time Assets

Quality Score (1 to 10 per keyword) shows where the quality part needs work.

Read the detail
Two businesses bidding on the same keyword can pay very different prices per click. Google lists six things that feed Ad Rank: your bid, the quality of your ad and landing page, Ad Rank thresholds, how competitive the auction is, the context of the search, and the expected impact of your ad assets (Source: Google Ads Help, 2026). In practice they fall into three groups.

Competition. Your bid, the minimum thresholds, and how close competing ads are. In crowded Malaysian categories such as insurance, legal and healthcare, more advertisers chase the same top spots, so the price goes up.

Quality. How useful and relevant Google judges your ad and landing page to be. Google says higher quality ads can often lead to lower CPCs. This is the one lever fully in your control.

Context. The search term itself, the person's location, their device and the time of the search, plus how your sitelinks, callouts and other assets are expected to perform.

Quality Score is where you see the quality part. It is a 1 to 10 rating for each keyword, built from expected clickthrough rate, ad relevance and landing page experience. Google is clear that Quality Score is a diagnostic tool, not an input in the auction (Source: Google Ads Help, 2026). But it measures the same things the auction rewards, so a main keyword stuck at 3 or 4 tells you exactly where to work: the ad, the landing page, or the click appeal.

Real RM numbers

### How much does a Google Ads click cost in Malaysia?

Top of page bids in Malaysia run from RM4 to RM320. Specific searches cost far less than broad ones.

Keyword | Top of page bid, low | Top of page bid, high

google ads malaysia | RM13 | RM320

performance max | RM46 | RM320

google ads pricing malaysia | RM6 | RM320

sem agency malaysia | RM5 | RM81

google ads conversion tracking | RM4 | RM77

google ads agency malaysia | RM11 | RM61

Google Keyword Planner, Malaysia, October 2026.

Same platform, very different prices

#### The spread is huge

One keyword runs from RM13 to RM320.

#### Bids, not prices

Your actual cost per click is often lower.

#### Specific is cheaper

"google ads agency malaysia" tops out at RM61. "google ads malaysia" reaches RM320.

Run your own keywords through Keyword Planner before you set a budget.

Read the detail
Here are the top of page bid ranges Google Keyword Planner shows for six Malaysian searches in our own category. The low number is roughly the 20th percentile of what advertisers have historically bid to appear at the top of the page. The high number is roughly the 80th percentile (Source: Google Ads Help, 2026).

Three things stand out. First, the spread is huge. The same keyword can run from RM13 to RM320 depending on who is bidding, when and where. Second, these are bids, not prices. Your actual cost per click is often lower, and better ads pull it lower again. Third, specific searches are cheaper than broad ones. "google ads agency malaysia" tops out at RM61 while "google ads malaysia" reaches RM320, because the broad term pulls in every advertiser who sells anything close to it.

Run your own keywords through Keyword Planner before you set a budget. Your industry's range is the only one that matters. For cost benchmarks across Google, Meta and TikTok, see what advertising costs in Malaysia .

Minimum budget

### What is the minimum Google Ads budget in Malaysia?

Google has no minimum. Plan RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month in ad spend so you collect enough data to make good decisions.

General floor

RM1,500 to RM2,000

A month in ad spend. The same floor we apply across paid media.

Competitive Search

Around RM3,000

A month for Google Search in categories such as insurance, legal and healthcare.

The arithmetic: RM2,000 a month is about RM66 a day

RM5 clicks

About 13 a day

Roughly 400 a month. Enough to read the search terms and see what converts.

RM20 clicks

About 3 a day

A week of that tells you almost nothing. Results come in too slowly to judge.

Start with one focused Search campaign on your highest intent keywords.

Read the detail
Google has no minimum. You could run a campaign on RM10 a day. The real question is how little you can spend and still learn something.

Our guidance is RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month in ad spend as the floor , the same floor we apply across paid media. For Google Search in competitive categories, we recommend around RM3,000 a month .

The reason is arithmetic. RM2,000 a month is about RM66 a day. If your clicks cost RM5, that buys around 13 clicks a day and roughly 400 a month. That is enough to read the search terms, see what converts and cut what does not. If your clicks cost RM20, the same budget buys about 3 clicks a day. A week of that data tells you almost nothing, and results come in too slowly to judge.

Below the floor, money is not wasted because Google overcharges. It is wasted because you never collect enough data to make a good decision. Start with one tightly focused Search campaign on your highest intent keywords instead of spreading a small budget across Search, Display and Performance Max. Our Performance Max guide covers when it is worth adding.

Cost per lead

### What cost per lead should you expect from Google Ads?

There is no single Malaysian benchmark. Compare your cost per lead with what a customer is worth to you.

Read the detail
There is no single Malaysian benchmark. Cost per lead depends on what a customer is worth in your industry and how many advertisers want the same customer. Two of our own Google accounts show the range.

Insurance and fintech platform, 12 months. Cost per lead fell 45%, from RM4.40 to RM2.41, while monthly spend scaled from RM5,000 to RM20,000. Leads grew 393%, from 1,336 to 6,586 in the peak month. High search volume and a simple sign up keep each lead cheap.

Healthcare group, 30 days to 5 October 2026. CPA was RM91.47, from 175 conversions on RM16.1K spend. That is the fourth rise in a row: RM55.11, RM61.45, RM69.46, RM76.78, then RM91.47. The latest rise came on flat spend. A newer service line campaign converts at RM64, against RM105 for the main Search campaign. A patient is worth far more than an insurance sign up, so a higher CPA can still be profitable.

The lesson: compare your cost per lead with what a customer is worth to you, not with another industry's number. Expect it to rise as you scale, because the cheapest searches get bought first. Current figures sit on our Live Results Board , updated weekly.

Overpaying

### How do you know if you are overpaying for Google Ads?

Overpaying shows up as small leaks, not one big number. If two or more of these apply, an audit usually pays for itself.

Red flag

#### Nobody reads the search terms

In our audits, broad match with no negatives often sends 20 to 40% of spend to searches that never buy.

Red flag

#### Conversions are not real leads

Page views or button clicks counted as conversions send bidding after the wrong thing.

Red flag

#### Quality Score stuck at 3 or 4

On your main keywords. Check the ad, landing page and expected clickthrough rate.

Red flag

#### Performance Max buys your brand

You may be paying for people already searching for you by name.

Red flag

#### You cannot see your account

You should always have admin access, whoever runs it.

Red flag

#### Cost per lead rising, unexplained

Three months up and nobody can say why. Rising with scale can be normal.

Run the full checklist with our Google Ads audit guide .

Read the detail
Overpaying rarely shows up as one big number. It shows up as small leaks. Check these six.

- Nobody reads the search terms report. In our audits, broad match with no negative keywords often sends 20 to 40% of spend to searches that will never buy.

- Conversions are not real leads. If page views or button clicks count as conversions, automated bidding chases the wrong thing. Our conversion tracking guide shows how to fix it.

- Quality Score sits at 3 or 4 on your main keywords. Check the three components to see whether the ad, the landing page or the expected clickthrough rate is dragging.

- Performance Max is buying your own brand name. You may be paying for people who were already searching for you by name.

- You cannot see your own ad account. You should always have admin access to your account and its data, whoever runs it.

- Cost per lead has risen for three months and nobody can explain why. Rising costs can be normal when you scale. Unexplained rising costs are not.

If two or more apply, an audit will usually pay for itself. Our Google Ads audit guide walks through the full checklist, and our Google Ads takeover guide shows how we fix accounts without resetting what they have learned. Or let us run the audit on your account for free through our Google Ads agency service .

Pricing questions

### What Malaysian businesses ask about Google Ads costs.

Straight answers on budgets, bids, tax and fees.

How much does Google Ads cost in Malaysia?
+

There are two costs. Ad spend is paid to Google per click, plus 8% SST, and you control it with a daily budget. Management is a separate monthly fee if you hire help. Management fees start from RM800 a month, depending on objective and account size. Most Malaysian SMEs should plan at least RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month in ad spend.

What is the minimum budget for Google Ads in Malaysia?
+

Google has no minimum spend. In practice, RM1,500 to RM2,000 a month is the floor to collect enough clicks and conversions to make decisions, and around RM3,000 a month suits Search in competitive categories such as insurance, legal and healthcare.

Why did Google spend more than my daily budget?
+

Google lets a campaign spend up to two times its average daily budget on a busy day, but across a month it will not charge more than 30.4 times the average daily budget. A campaign set at RM100 a day will not cost more than RM3,040 in a month.

Why are some Google Ads keywords so expensive?
+

More advertisers bidding means higher prices. Google Keyword Planner shows top of page bids in Malaysia from RM4 to RM320 depending on the keyword. Broad, high value searches cost more than specific ones, and better ad and landing page quality can often lower what you pay per click.

What cost per lead should I expect from Google Ads?
+

It depends on your industry. Our insurance account finished at RM2.41 per lead. A healthcare account ran at RM91.47 per conversion over the 30 days to 5 October 2026. Judge your cost per lead against what a customer is worth to you, not against another industry's number.

Does Google charge tax on ads in Malaysia?
+

Yes. Google Ads accounts with a Malaysian business address are subject to 8% sales and service tax, which has applied since 1 March 2024. Factor it into your monthly budget.

# Performance Max Malaysia

Performance Max Malaysia: When PMax Works for SMEs | ADV

← All guides & resources

Performance Max · 2026 Guide

## Performance Max for Malaysian Businesses

PMax puts one budget across all of Google and lets Google decide where it goes. It works when your account tells Google the truth about what a customer is.

Get a Free Account Audit
Jump to the Setup Checklist

"PMax is only as smart as the conversion you feed it."

The short answer

Performance Max (PMax) is a Google Ads campaign type that runs one budget across Search, Maps, YouTube, Discover, Gmail and the Display Network, with Google's bidding deciding where each ringgit goes. For a Malaysian SME it works best once conversion tracking records real enquiries or sales, and it should sit alongside a Search campaign rather than replace it. Without brand exclusions, negative keywords and a weekly look at the search terms report, it tends to drift toward your own brand searches and cheap placements.

### What is Performance Max (PMax)?

One Google Ads campaign, one budget, six channels. You set the goal and assets. Google's bidding decides where each ringgit goes.

- Search

- Maps

- YouTube

- Discover

- Gmail

- Display Network

Link a Merchant Center feed and PMax also serves Shopping ads.

One budget, six channels, one control layer

Read the detail
Performance Max is a goal-based Google Ads campaign. You give it a budget, a conversion goal and a set of assets. Google's Smart Bidding then decides which channel, placement and search to buy, bidding to maximise conversions or conversion value, with an optional target CPA or target ROAS. (Source: Google Ads Help, About Performance Max campaigns, 2026)

Google currently lists six channels for Performance Max. (Source: Google Ads Help, About Performance Max channels, 2026)

- Search: Google.com, the Google Search app and Search partners.

- Maps: Google Maps and Waze.

- YouTube: video and non-video ads on YouTube.

- Discover: ads in the Discover feed.

- Gmail: ads inside Gmail inboxes.

- Google Display Network: websites and apps, outside Gmail and YouTube.

Link a Google Merchant Center feed and PMax also serves Shopping ads. The catch: you hand over where the money goes, so what you feed it decides what you get back.

### Should a Malaysian SME run Performance Max or Search?

Start with Search. Add PMax once you know what a Search lead costs you. Ecommerce with a product feed can lead with PMax.

Lead generation

#### Search first, PMax second

Clinics, insurance, B2B services, education, home services

- PMax adds reach on YouTube, Display and Gmail.

- Leads there are cheaper but often weaker.

- Optimise toward qualified leads, not every form.

Ecommerce with a feed

#### PMax is often the main campaign

- Shopping ads show product, price and image.

- A clean feed matters more than clever copy.

- Exact match wins Identical searches go to your Search campaign, not PMax.

- Readiness test Cannot say what a Search lead costs? Not ready for PMax.

Read the detail
Start with Search, where people type what they need. Then decide on PMax based on what you sell.

Lead generation (clinics, insurance, B2B services, education, home services): Search first, PMax second. PMax adds reach on YouTube, Display and Gmail, where leads are cheaper but often weaker. If your conversion action counts every form, PMax will find the cheapest forms. Google's own advice for lead campaigns is to optimise toward conversion actions close to the final sale, such as qualified or converted leads, while keeping enough volume to learn from. (Source: Google Ads Help, Answering Your Top Questions About Performance Max, 2026)

Ecommerce with a Merchant Center feed: PMax is often the main campaign. Shopping placements show product, price and image, so a clean feed matters more than clever copy.

One rule worth knowing. If a search is identical to an exact match keyword in your Search campaign, Google prioritises the Search campaign over PMax. (Source: Google Ads Help, How Performance Max interacts with other campaigns in your account, 2026) So keep proven keywords in Search on exact match, structured the way our Google Ads Malaysia guide describes, and let PMax work the rest.

A simple test: if you cannot yet say what a lead from Search costs you, you are not ready for PMax.

### What do you need before launching Performance Max?

Tracking that counts real enquiries or sales, enough conversions, a budget for two campaigns, and a full asset set.

- Tracking that records revenue Forms, WhatsApp chats, qualified calls, purchases. Not page views.

- Enough conversions A handful a month is too little to learn from.

- Budget for two campaigns Around RM3,000 a month Usually shared with Search.

- A full set of assets Text, images, logo and your own video.

Google's best practice per asset group 15 headlines 5 descriptions 7 images 1 video

Character limits Headline 30 Long headline 90 Description 90 Business name 25

Read the detail
1. Conversion tracking that records revenue actions. Forms, WhatsApp chats, qualified calls, purchases. Not page views. Smart Bidding scales whatever you call a conversion. Our conversion tracking guide walks through the setup.

2. Enough conversions to learn from. Google does not publish a minimum conversion count for PMax. Our view: with only a handful of real conversions a month, PMax has too little to learn from.

3. A budget that can carry two campaigns. We suggest around RM3,000 a month if PMax will share the budget with Search (see our Google Ads management page). A thin budget split two ways helps neither. Our Google Ads pricing guide has the full breakdown.

4. A full set of assets. These are Google's current specs per asset group. (Source: Google Ads Help, Performance Max campaigns specs and format requirements, 2026)

Asset | Google's spec

Headlines | Up to 30 characters each, 3 to 15 per asset group, at least one of 15 characters or less

Long headlines | Up to 90 characters each, 1 to 5

Descriptions | Up to 90 characters each, 2 to 5

Business name | Up to 25 characters, matching your domain or verified business name

Images | Landscape 1.91:1 (1200 x 628 recommended) and square 1:1 (1200 x 1200) required; portrait 4:5 optional; up to 20 of each

Logo | Square 1:1 required (1200 x 1200 recommended), up to 5

Video | Optional, 10 seconds or longer, up to 15 per orientation. With none, Google may auto-generate videos from your assets

Google's best practice is at least 15 headlines, 5 descriptions, 7 images and 1 video. (Source: Google Ads Help, Optimization tips for Performance Max campaigns, 2026) Supply your own video. An auto-generated slideshow rarely builds trust. For ecommerce, also fix Merchant Center feed errors first, because feed errors become ad errors.

### What are the risks of Performance Max?

Left alone, PMax drifts to your own brand and cheap placements, and hides which channel really worked.

- Red flag Spend on your own brand A lovely CPA built on people who already knew you.

- Red flag Spend on cheap placements Cheap Display and app clicks, while sales stay flat.

- Red flag Limited transparency No bids per channel. The placement report is not for judging results.

Our answer: judge PMax on the account's blended cost per lead.

Read the detail
Budget drifts to your own brand. People searching your business name would have found you anyway. PMax can claim those conversions and report a lovely CPA built on people who already knew you.

Budget drifts to cheap placements. Display and app inventory is cheap per click. If your goal counts weak actions, PMax buys them there while sales stay flat.

Limited transparency. You do not set bids per channel. The PMax placement report shows where ads served and their impressions, and Google itself says it should not be used to evaluate performance because it does not cover all channels. (Source: Google Ads Help, Find or create placement reports for your Performance Max campaigns, 2026) So we judge PMax on the account's blended cost per lead, not its own column.

### What controls does Google give you over Performance Max in 2026?

Exclusions, negatives, search themes and two key reports. Negatives only touch Search and Shopping inventory.

- Brand exclusions Search, Shopping and YouTube search.

- Campaign negatives Up to 10,000 Search and Shopping only.

- Account negatives Up to 1,000 Search and Shopping, PMax included.

- Placement exclusions Display and YouTube.

- Search terms report With landing pages, by ad format.

- Channel performance report Clicks, conversions and cost by channel.

- Search themes Up to 50 Per asset group, to point PMax at intent.

- Device and age controls Plus cost and conversions per asset.

Negatives do nothing on Display, YouTube or Gmail. There, your conversion goal does the steering.

Read the detail
More than at launch. This is what we verified on Google's help pages in October 2026.

- Brand exclusions. Brand lists stop PMax serving on your own brand, competitors or sub-brands, across Search, Shopping and YouTube search inventory. They also catch misspellings.

- Campaign-level negative keywords and lists. Up to 10,000 per PMax campaign, for Search and Shopping inventory only.

- Account-level negative keywords. Up to 1,000, applied across Search and Shopping inventory, PMax included.

- Placement exclusions. PMax respects account-level and manager account placement exclusions for Display and YouTube.

- Search terms report. "Search terms and landing pages for Performance Max", segmentable by ad format.

- Channel performance report. Under Insights and reports, with clicks, conversions and cost by channel and ad format.

- Search themes. Up to 50 per asset group, to point PMax at intent you care about.

- Device and age controls, and full asset reporting with conversions, cost and clicks per asset.

(Source: Google Ads Help, Performance Max control and reporting pages, 2026)

Note the gap: negative keywords do nothing on Display, YouTube or Gmail. There, your conversion goal does most of the steering.

### How long does Performance Max take to learn?

Give a new PMax campaign at least 6 weeks before you judge it, and change one thing at a time.

6 weeks
Minimum run for a new campaign

1 to 2 weeks
Or one full conversion cycle, after any significant change

Week 2
Too early to pause because the CPA looks high

Read the detail
Google's guidance is to run a new PMax campaign for at least 6 weeks, and to allow 1 to 2 weeks, or at least one full conversion cycle, after a significant change. (Source: Google Ads Help, Optimization tips for Performance Max campaigns, 2026) So do not change budget, goal and assets in the same week, and do not pause it in week two because the CPA looks high.

### How do you set up Performance Max step by step?

Fix tracking and protect Search first, add your exclusions, then build the campaign and judge it at 6 weeks.

- 01 Audit conversion tracking One revenue conversion, tested with a real enquiry.

- 02 Protect your Search campaign Proven keywords on exact match keep priority.

- 03 Add brand exclusions Your own brand and any you will not pay for.

- 04 Load negative keywords Obvious waste (jobs, free, training), plus a campaign list.

- 05 Add placement exclusions At account level, from data you already have.

- 06 Create the campaign Maximise conversions first. Target CPA once costs are stable.

- 07 Build asset groups by service line One per service line or product category, each with its own final URL.

- 08 Decide on final URL expansion Leave it on only if your other pages convert.

- 09 Review weekly, judge at 6 weeks Read the reports weekly. Judge on blended cost per lead.

Read the detail

- Audit conversion tracking. One primary conversion that means revenue, tested with a real enquiry.

- Protect your Search campaign. Keep proven keywords on exact match in Search so they keep priority.

- Add brand exclusions. Apply a brand list covering your own brand and any others you will not pay for.

- Load negative keywords. Account-level negatives for obvious waste (jobs, free, training), plus a campaign-level list.

- Add placement exclusions at account level, from placement data you already have.

- Create the campaign. Pick the goal, start on maximise conversions, set your locations, and add a target CPA only once costs are stable.

- Build one asset group per service line or product category, each with its own final URL, assets, audience signals and search themes.

- Decide on final URL expansion. Leave it on only if your other pages convert.

- Review weekly, judge at 6 weeks. Read the search terms, channel performance and placement reports weekly. Judge on blended cost per lead.

### How does ADV run Performance Max?

Clean tracking first, a split by service line, and the expectation that cost per result rises as spend grows.

"An account that counts page views as conversions gets worse under PMax, not better."

- Tracking first The first thing we check in every Google Ads audit .

- Split by service line RM59 vs RM83 30 days to 24 Sep 2026. Separate asset groups, or campaigns when values differ.

- Costs rise with spend RM55.11 to RM91.47 30 day readings to 5 Oct 2026. The channel report shows where the extra cost went.

Why we split by service line

Read the detail
We only run PMax once tracking is clean. It is the first thing we check in every Google Ads audit. An account that counts page views as conversions gets worse under PMax, not better.

Second, we split by service line. In a healthcare group's account, over the 30 days to 24 Sep 2026, a newer service line ran in its own campaign at RM59 per conversion, against RM83 for the main Search campaign. That was not a PMax campaign, but the lesson carries over. In one shared campaign the cheaper line would have vanished into an average. In PMax we use separate asset groups, and separate campaigns when service lines have different values, because budget is set per campaign.

Third, we expect cost per result to rise with spend. The same account's CPA has risen across four consecutive 30 day readings, from RM55.11 to RM91.47, with 175 conversions on RM16.1K in the 30 days to 5 Oct 2026. PMax does not escape that. It just hides where the extra cost went unless someone reads the channel report.

That is how our Google Ads agency service runs PMax. Our guide to advertising costs in Malaysia shows how Google fits next to Meta.

Current numbers are on our Live Results Board .

### What Malaysian businesses ask about Performance Max.

Straight answers on lead quality, budget, brand traffic and how long to wait.

What is Performance Max in Google Ads?
+

A Google Ads campaign type that runs one budget across Search, Maps, YouTube, Discover, Gmail and the Display Network. You supply a budget, a conversion goal and assets, and Google's Smart Bidding decides where your ads show.

Is Performance Max good for lead generation in Malaysia?
+

Yes, once Search is working and tracking counts real enquiries. If every form fill counts as a conversion, PMax will find the cheapest and weakest forms. Optimise toward qualified leads where you can.

How much budget do I need for Performance Max in Malaysia?
+

We suggest around RM3,000 a month if PMax will share the budget with Search. A thin budget split two ways helps neither, and results come in too slowly to judge.

Can I stop Performance Max from showing on my brand name?
+

Yes. Apply a brand list as a brand exclusion on the PMax campaign. It covers Search, Shopping and YouTube search inventory and catches misspellings. Keep brand terms in their own Search campaign.

How long before I can judge a Performance Max campaign?
+

Google recommends running a new Performance Max campaign for at least 6 weeks, and allowing 1 to 2 weeks or one full conversion cycle after a significant change. Check reports weekly, but judge results after that.

# Google Ads Conversion Tracking Malaysia
